comment: Hardened config for an UNATTENDED, looped jichi run. See docs/AUTONOMOUS_LOOPS.md. Sets the security POSTURE and the three reporting tools; per-run bounds (budgets, --verify, --edit-scope) belong on the loop.sh command line, not here. Replace the model block and put report.sh/db-report.sh/http-report.sh on PATH (or use absolute paths in each tool's command) before use.

tools.name: report_status
tools.description: Report a short human-readable status line to the operator's report file. Use this to record progress and the final outcome of a task.

tools.name: db_report
tools.description: Record a structured result row (status + count) in the operator's database. The connection is fixed by the operator; you only choose the status and count.

count.description: A non-negative count relevant to the task.

tools.name: http_report
tools.description: POST a short summary to the operator's fixed reporting endpoint. The URL is fixed by the operator; you only supply the summary text.

summary.description: A short summary of what was accomplished.
